verdict.rationale: Asking about official SDKs is a fair question for an IP office service, since IP offices can publish programmatic APIs and client libraries, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only procedural filing services (patents, utility models, designs, trademarks, renewals) and online request forms. Nothing mentions an API, SDK, or developer library, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
